ITEM 1 | Crumbly, opaque white cubes and curds with soft, slightly moist surface, forming a large mound across the upper-left and center of a white square plate, pieces about 1-2 cm, some flaking loosely at the edges, sitting under and beside the red sauce | 180
ITEM 2 | Thick, glossy, brick-red sauce with a rough, chunky texture and slight sheen, covering the top of the white cheese-like mound in an irregular blob about 8 x 6 cm, with a thin layer seeping down the cubes | 60
ITEM 3 | Golden-tan cubes with slightly browned, crisp-looking edges and a dry, matte surface, roughly 2-3 cm each, clustered on the right side of the plate; some have a darker glazed-looking patch on one face | 110
ITEM 4 | Watermelon wedges with bright pink-red flesh, moist and juicy surface, scattered black seeds visible, pieces about 3-4 cm triangular slices, located at the right-middle edge of the plate | 95
ITEM 5 | Whole and halved strawberries, glossy bright red with small green-white stem caps, moist surface, arranged at the bottom-right edge of the plate | 55
ITEM 6 | Small dark blueberries, glossy and round about 1 cm, scattered among the strawberries and near the fruit cluster at the bottom center | 25
ITEM 7 | Cubed yellow-orange fruit pieces with slightly translucent, moist edges and a smooth surface, about 2 cm chunks, clustered on the lower-left of the plate | 70
ITEM 8 | Orange-salmon melon cubes with smooth, moist surface and slight sheen, about 2-3 cm pieces, placed at the bottom left next to the yellow fruit | 75
